text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
choice_data_list: Please take good care of that plushie.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Understood. Please leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I have a teddy bear in my room 
from my grandparents, so I am quite 
accustomed to handling them.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I think I will display this plushie right 
next to it and take good care of it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I'm glad we have more friends 
now.
